mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_usage_daily (day, purpose, provider, model, calls, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{day}, #{purpose}, #{provider}, #{model}, 1, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}) ON CONFLICT (day, purpose, provider, model) DO UPDATE SET calls = model_usage_daily.calls + 1, input_tokens = model_usage_daily.input_tokens + EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = model_usage_daily.output_tokens + EXCLUDED.output_tokens
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM model_usage_daily ORDER BY model
